notes.title: Update for 2/26/2025
notes.notes:
Camera systems maintenance
 Cinematic cameras implemented with auto focus
 Scroll wheel acts as zoom input for all controlled cameras, middle mouse button to reset
 Keys 2 through 7 are independent Free cameras
 Prototype phone camera mode added, 8 enables the phone camera, 9 toggles front/rear camera
 Nuke, Give Weapon & Drop Weapon interactions added
 Prototype mocap melee hit detection, when in a mocap mode swing the weapon fast enough to hit
  keys adjust voice chat range through modes; Whisper, Talk (Default), Yell & Global. Global is restricted to streamers and those granted moderator of the session
 Various fixes, improvements, and minor optimizations

notes.title: Update for 2/18/2025
notes.notes:
Various bug fixes
 New Slow Motion interaction

notes.title: Update for 1/20/2025
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue causing some avatar registrations to fail during upload.
Avatars now show author on the selection menu.

notes.title: Update for January 17, 2025
notes.notes: This update limits spawning of remote avatars to one at a time to see if it helps with performance when joining busy sessions.

notes.title: Update for January 16, 2025
notes.notes:
Added a Worlds menu to make switching sessions easier.
Adjusted voice chat falloff distance.

notes.title: Update for January 15, 2025
notes.notes:
Note: This patch is redownloading most of the content, but future patches should be smaller.

UI rework is continuing and some functionality may be missing while we work on it. Please direct feedback to the MikoVerse discord.

notes.title: Update for Dec 30, 2024
notes.notes:
Fixed items from the previous session showing up when joining a new session
 Improved performance for owners of a large number of items in a session
 Updated avatar texture compression to handle textures that are not a power of 2 in size; texture width/height must still be divisible by 4 to be compressed though

notes.title: UI changes and texture compression
notes.notes:
This update includes work-in-progress UI changes and texture compression for registered avatars.


 The main interface is now toggled on and off with Escape instead of Tab
 Logout/Quit moved to the main menu
 Registering an avatar will generate compressed textures that are saved on the server
 Existing registered avatars can have compressed textures added by going to the Edit screen for the avatar

notes.title: Changes for build 6365
notes.notes:
The voice chat system can now be toggled with F5. This will disable your voice being sent to other users as well as receiving their voice chat.
 Fixed a crash when pressing the push-to-talk button or toggling talking (F4) with no input device.
 Reduced VRAM usage with some custom avatars and multiple instances of the same avatar in a session.
 Part of custom avatar loading is now asynchronous to reduce the duration of the hitch when loading.
 Voice chat audio and attenuation have been adjusted.
 Physics gun fixes and improvements have been made.
 Wardrobe fixes have been made.

notes.title: Stability and Backend Update
notes.notes: We have patched various things related to loading a large amount of entities in a session. This should hopefully make for a smoother time inside the MikoVerse.

notes.title: The Persistent Object Patch
notes.notes:
Objects are now persistent!

With this, many systems may see an increase in instability.

Please report all issues!

notes.title: Post Initial Stress Test Update
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone helping us test this app in its current state, and more thanks to those helping the onboarding of others. We've learned some things.

IN THIS BUILD, THERE IS AN ABILITY TO BUY A CURRENCY THAT CURRENTLY HAS NO MECHANISM TO SPEND. THE STORE IS IN PROGRESS.

* Beginning of money signaling from stripe
* Improvements to the "worlds all loading at origin" problem
* Improvements to handling of Twitch events
* Improvements to account based activities (more info later)
* Minor improvements to UI
* Fixes to AutoDOF
* Initial StretchSense glove support
* Background work on new labyrinth map, *soon*
